question: Walking at (3)/(4) of his normal speed from his home, Tarun is 19 minutes late in reaching his office. The usual time taken by him to cover the distance between his home and his office is :
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed becomes 3/4 ⇒ time becomes 4/3

Extra time = (4/3 − 1) = 1/3 of usual time

1/3 of usual time = 19 min

Usual time = 19 × 3 = 57 min

**∴ Answer = 57 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Reduced speed = 3/4 of normal speed

Late time = 19 minutes

**Formula used:**

Time is inversely proportional to speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let normal time = T

⇒ New time = T × (4/3)

⇒ Delay = (4T/3 − T)

⇒ = T/3

⇒ T/3 = 19

⇒ T = 19 × 3 = 57 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 57 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed-Time Inverse Relation

If speed changes by a/b, time changes by b/a.

Delay Formula

Delay = New time − Normal time.

Shortcut Concept

Extra fraction of time = (1 − speed ratio) ÷ speed ratio.
